features.title: Workspace layout and identity
features.summary: A self-contained, file-native Workspace directory, selected explicitly by the CLI, holds the `.uiux/workspace.json` manifest, one canonical JSON file per View, UX Flow, Review thread and locale, and one directory per authored Asset; every resource has an immutable UUID identity that matches its file or directory name.

features.title: Workspace schema versioning and migration
features.summary: The manifest records one Workspace `schemaVersion` (current: 3). An older recognized Workspace opens read-only until it is upgraded explicitly, atomically and deterministically through the CLI-only `uiux migrate` (with a writing-nothing `--dry-run`, refused while a `uiux dev` server holds the Workspace); there is no HTTP or MCP migration entrypoint.

features.title: Domain mutations and revision concurrency
features.summary: Every canonical change goes through a domain-specific, atomic mutation that requires the resource's current opaque `expectedRevision`; a stale revision writes nothing and reports the current revision, there is no generic file write, and out-of-band edits are detected. `/api/*` and `/mcp` are separate transport adapters over one shared application layer (MCP never calls `/api/*` over loopback HTTP), so HTTP, MCP and the Workbench share the same semantics.

features.title: Reference integrity and destructive changes
features.summary: Destructive or identity-changing operations (deleting a View, UX Flow or Asset; renaming a Variant or a render-dimension key) first report their known reference impact and proceed only after explicit acknowledgement; they stay target-local, never cascade or auto-rebind, and leave dangling references as repairable diagnostics.

features.title: View structure and RootShell
features.summary: A View is one canonical JSON resource whose Widget IR is rooted at the UIUX-managed RootShell Widget (reserved ID `root`) with exactly one `content` Slot of ordered child Widgets; UIUX validates only that reserved boundary and leaves the executable Widget IR to adapters, and an optional View-local `feature` tag groups Views for display.

features.title: Agent edit leases
features.summary: An agent's write to a View, UX Flow, locale, Asset or the Workspace settings takes a renewable five-minute per-resource lease (also via `acquire_lock` / `release_lock`); other writers are refused with `resource.locked`, leases complement but never replace `expectedRevision`, Review threads are never leased, and an Owner can force-release.
